title: Revenue Management Clause: Concession Rent on a Noticed Increase, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Clause.** A retention concession on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement gives back the retention concession share of the space class of the noticed increase, and it never gives back more than $8.00, the give-back ceiling. The noticed increase is the new rent of the most recent rent increase notice on the agreement less the rent before that increase. The amount given back is that share multiplied by the noticed increase, or $8.00 where that product is higher. The concession rent is the increased rent less the amount given back, rounded down to the cent, and it is never lower than the rent before the increase.

### Worked figures (hypothetical increases; class share 50%)

| Rent before the increase | Increased rent | Noticed increase | Share of it | Given back (at most $8.00) | Concession rent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $150.00 | $159.00 | $9.00 | $4.50 | $4.50 | $154.50 |
| $200.00 | $220.00 | $20.00 | $10.00 | $8.00 | $212.00 |
| $133.33 | $141.18 | $7.85 | $3.925 | $3.925 | $137.25 (from $137.255, rounded down) |

### Points of judgement

- The share is applied to the noticed increase, never to the whole rent.
- Rounding is downward, to the cent, and applies to the concession rent, not to the amount given back.
- However the figures fall, the concession rent stands at or above the rent before the increase.
